_about: Canvas presets seen in the 17 @__dviet videos (references/dviet_19/INDEX.md). platform_safe_zones.json is unchanged and remains the source for 9:16; the other canvases carry safe boxes scaled from it. Scaled boxes are derived estimates, not platform-published values.

9x16_1080_60.notes: Default of the skill and 13 of 17 videos.

9x16_1080_30.notes: Same geometry as 60 fps; only frame counts change (halve every 60 fps frame count, double the 30 fps base of atomic_motion_library.json). Seen in 7677448217667063061.

4x3_1440_24.notes: Storytelling canvas of 7706183278461570356. Text sits beside the subject (negative space), not on the chest; do not reuse 9:16 y percentages.

wide_1332_30.notes: Text-first canvas of 7664835388476755220; constellation layout is defined on this canvas.

safe_zone_scaling_rule.landscape_and_4x3: scale the 16:9 entry of platform_safe_zones.json: x by (width / 1920), y by (height / 1080). Percent-based caption y (dviet_style_tokens.json caption_y_pct) is defined for 9:16 only.
safe_zone_scaling_rule.fps: fps does not change safe zones; it changes frame counts only.

limits: The compositor and compile_and_verify pipeline are written for 1080x1920; non-9:16 canvases are data here and are not verified end to end.
